tagline: India's Bay of Bengal island-hopping archipelago — Port Blair to Havelock and Neil, today a 1.5–2 hr diesel fast-ferry that a foiling layer turns into a fast, quiet, all-electric hop.
summary: The Andaman Islands are India's marquee tropical island-hopping destination: Port Blair is the gateway (airport plus the Haddo and Phoenix Bay jetties) feeding the two star islands — Havelock (Swaraj Dweep, home to Radhanagar Beach) and Neil (Shaheed Dweep) — alongside Ross Island, North Bay and Baratang. Inter-island movement runs entirely on diesel fast-ferries (Makruzz, Green Ocean, Nautika) and the government ferry; Port Blair to Havelock is ~38 nm and 1.5–2 hours, Havelock to Neil ~10 nm. Every leg sits inside Pioneer II's 70 nm all-electric envelope. Demand is tourism-led and growing strongly — arrivals topped 7 lakh in 2024 and the central and union-territory governments are actively expanding Andaman connectivity and tourism. A foiling-electric layer offers fast, stable, quiet, zero-wake transit ideal for the coral-rich, ecologically protected waters around the islands.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: All core hops — Port Blair ↔ Havelock (~38 nm), Havelock ↔ Neil (~10 nm) and Port Blair ↔ Neil (~22 nm) — sit inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope over warm, largely protected water, a clean product-market fit, while the coral-rich marine parks make zero-wake, near-silent foiling an environmental differentiator over the diesel fleet.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta LR's ~2,000 nm hybrid range, with no charging-infrastructure dependency, extends the network south toward the Little and Great Nicobar group and supports mainland repositioning across the Bay of Bengal where island grid charging isn't viable.

competitive_landscape: Inter-island transport today is diesel fast-ferries (Makruzz, Green Ocean, Nautika) plus government ferries; no electric or foiling layer exists. Ola, Rapido and Uber operate land mobility in Indian metros and could provide an in-app land+water tie-in for arriving tourists.
seasonality: Oct–May is peak (calm seas, dry); Jun–Sep southwest monsoon brings rough seas and reduced sailings.
regulatory_note: Andaman is a Union Territory; marine tourism and inter-island transport are regulated by the A&N Administration and Directorate of Shipping Services. Confirm charter/operator licensing and protected-area clearances.
signature_routes: Port Blair ↔ Ross Island ↔ North Bay
